description: PRD-202 — Tenant Context Concurrency Fix. Replace the deprecated AsyncLocalStorage enterWith() tenant-context binding (cross-tenant leak vector on Railway's persistent Node process) with the safe runWithTenantContext() scope. Separate tenant resolution from context binding, deliver the withTenantContext request wrapper, harden the Prisma middleware to fail loud on missing context, and prove isolation under concurrency.

userStories.title: Harden Prisma middleware: fail loud on missing context (AC-6/AC-6a)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a tenant-scoped query that runs with no bound context to fail loudly (throw in strict mode, warn+emit otherwise) instead of silently running unscoped, with an explicit escape hatch for legitimate system queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Add TenantContextMissingError (carries route/model/action) and a context-free allow-list (default-deny; system models enumerated per OQ-2) in lib/db.ts or a small lib/tenant-scope-policy.ts

Middleware distinguishes implicit-unbound (hasTenantContext()===false) from explicit null (runWithTenantContext(null,...)): implicit null on a tenant-scoped, non-allow-listed model emits security.tenant_context_missing (structured console.warn {route?,model,action}) and throws TenantContextMissingError when strict mode is on; explicit null proceeds unscoped (AC-6/AC-6a)
Strict mode gated by env flag (e.g. TENANT_CONTEXT_STRICT) defaulting OFF in prod so the ~96 not-yet-wrapped routes (PRD-203 surface) keep working; ON in test (OQ-3 warn-then-throw)
bypassTenantScope(fn) documented escape hatch = runWithTenantContext(null, fn) with a clear name (AC-6a)

Pure decision helper (e.g. shouldThrowOnMissingContext(model, hasContext, strict, allowList)) is extracted and unit-tested node-only (tests/unit/tenant-scope-policy.test.ts) — full middleware throw is the Docker integration test US-011
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
